description: Construction of a part two- storey part single storey rear and side extension including relocation of the side entrance door to the front elevation
decision_conditions:
<div>The scale, siting and design of the proposed development is considered harmful to the appearance of the house, built form of the terrace and character of the area, notably given the location of the application site within the Becontree Estate.&nbsp; The proposed two-storey side extension would minimise the gap between the subject terrace dwelling and the terrace dwelling to the west, impacting a significant character trait of the Becontree Estate. As such, the proposed development is contrary to:<br></div><div><br></div><div><p><span style="font-size: 10.5pt; font-family: " pt="" sans",="" sans-serif;"="">-
